messages.name: CertificateInstallationReq
messages.description: Message used by the EVCC to request the installation of a contract certificate via the EVSE.

messages.name: SessionStopReq
messages.description: Request to stop the charging session.

messages.name: SessionStopRes
messages.description: Response to the request to stop the charging session.

messages.name: ClientHello
messages.description: Initiates the TLS handshake process.

messages.name: ServerHello
messages.description: Responds to the ClientHello message with server parameters.

messages.name: CertificateRequest
messages.description: Requests the client's certificate during the TLS handshake.

messages.name: Certificate
messages.description: Response containing the EVCC's certificate chain.

messages.name: NewSessionTicket
messages.description: Sets up the PSK for TLS session resumption. Each message provides a unique PSK for a separate TLS session tied to the same V2G session.

messages.name: AuthorizationReq
messages.description: Request for authorization containing identification mode.

messages.name: CertificateInstallationRes
messages.description: Response to certificate installation request containing signed installation data.

messages.name: MeteringConfirmationReq
messages.description: Request for metering confirmation containing message body.

messages.name: ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes
messages.description: Response to charge parameter discovery containing absolute price schedule.

messages.name: SECCDiscoveryRequest
messages.description: The SDP client sends out SECC discovery request messages to the local link (multicast) expecting any SDP server to answer its request.

messages.name: SECCDiscoveryResponse
messages.description: The SDP server responds to the SECC discovery request with a message containing the IP address and port number of the SECC.

messages.name: SECC discovery request
messages.description: The SDP client uses this message to request the IP address and the port number of the SECC.

messages.name: SDPRequestWireless
messages.description: SECC Discovery request message for wireless communication.

messages.name: SDPResponseWireless
messages.description: SECC Discovery response message for wireless communication providing the IP-address and port of the SECC.

messages.name: SDPRequest
messages.description: SDP request message for discovering the SECC.

messages.name: SDPResponse
messages.description: SDP response message containing SECC discovery information.

messages.name: SDP Request
messages.description: Request message for SDP containing CouplingType and other elements.

messages.name: SECC Discovery Response
messages.description: Response message from the SDP server containing payload as defined in Table 26 and Table 27.

messages.name: SDP_Request
messages.description: Message sent by the EVCC to initiate the SDP process, indicating the intention to use wireless power transfer.

messages.name: SDP_Response
messages.description: Message sent by the SECC in response to an SDP request, potentially containing DiagStatus and EVSEID.

messages.name: ACDP_VehiclePositioningRes
messages.description: Message sent by the SECC in response to a vehicle positioning request, indicating the result of the association process.

messages.name: supportedAppProtocolReq
messages.description: This request message provides a list of charging protocols supported by the EVCC.

messages.name: supportedAppProtocolRes
messages.description: Message sent by the SECC to confirm the selected application layer protocol.

messages.name: PowerDeliveryReq
messages.description: Request to start, stop, or enter standby mode for power delivery.

messages.name: PowerDeliveryRes
messages.description: Response indicating acceptance or rejection of the requested power delivery action.

messages.name: SessionSetup
messages.description: Initiates a V2G communication session.

messages.name: SessionStop
messages.description: Requests the termination of a V2G communication session.

messages.name: PowerDelivery
messages.description: Controls the start, stop, pause, or standby of power delivery.

messages.name: ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq
messages.description: Request for charge parameters discovery applicable to all energy transfer modes.

messages.name: ChargeLoopReq
messages.description: Request for charge loop applicable to all energy transfer modes.

messages.name: ChargeLoopRes
messages.description: Response to charge loop applicable to all energy transfer modes.

messages.name: SessionSetupReq
messages.description: Initial request message sent by the EVCC to start a new charging session.

messages.name: SessionSetupRes
messages.description: Response message sent by the SECC to acknowledge the start of a new charging session.

messages.name: ServiceDiscoveryReq
messages.description: Request message sent by the EVCC after SessionSetup to discover available services.

messages.name: AuthorizationSetupReq
messages.description: Message is empty, besides the header, and is only required to start the process of choosing the authorization method.

messages.name: AuthorizationSetupRes
messages.description: The SECC provides information about the available authorization modes and whether the certificate installation service is available.

messages.name: AuthorizationRes
messages.description: Response message for authorization request, indicating the acknowledgment status and processing status of the SECC.

messages.name: ServiceDiscoveryRes
messages.description: Response message from SECC to EVCC providing a list of all services available at the SECC.

messages.name: ServiceDetailReq
messages.description: By sending the ServiceDetailReq message the EVCC requests the SECC to send specific additional information about services offered by the EVSE.

messages.name: ServiceDetailRes
messages.description: The SECC responds with detailed information about the services requested by the EVCC in the ServiceDetailReq message.

messages.name: ServiceSelectionReq
messages.description: This request message transports the information on the selected services.

messages.name: ServiceSelectionRes
messages.description: This response message is sent by the SECC to confirm the selected services.

messages.name: ScheduleExchangeReq
messages.description: The EVCC provides its energy transfer parameters to the SECC.

messages.name: ScheduleExchangeRes
messages.description: With the ScheduleExchangeRes message the SECC provides applicable energy transfer parameters from the grid's perspective. Optionally, this also includes further information on cost over time, cost over demand, cost over consumption or a combination of these.

messages.name: MeteringConfirmationRes
messages.description: Response to MeteringConfirmationReq, acknowledging the confirmation.

messages.name: AC_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq
messages.description: The EVCC sends this message to provide its energy transfer parameters to the SECC, including status information about the EV's charging system capabilities.

messages.name: AC_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes
messages.description: Provides applicable charge parameters from the grid's perspective.

messages.name: AC_ChargeLoopReq
messages.description: Request message for continuous data exchange and sanity checks on meter readings during AC charging.

messages.name: AC_ChargeLoopRes
messages.description: Response message sent by the SECC to the EVCC after receiving the AC_ChargeLoopReq.

messages.name: DC_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq
messages.description: Initiates the negotiation of energy transfer parameters between the EVCC and SECC for DC charging.

messages.name: DC_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes
messages.description: Responds to the DC_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq with negotiated energy transfer parameters for DC charging.

messages.name: DC_CableCheckReq
messages.description: Asks for the cable check status of the EVSE and informs the EVSE about the connector lock status on the EV side and the readiness of the EV to transfer energy.

messages.name: DC_CableCheckRes
messages.description: Informs the EVCC about the result of the cable check and EVSE status after receiving the DC_CableCheckReq.

messages.name: DC_PreChargeReq
messages.description: Request message from EVCC to SECC to start the Pre Charge process.

messages.name: DC_PreChargeRes
messages.description: Response to DC_PreChargeReq, indicating the status of the Pre Charge process.

messages.name: DC_ChargeLoopReq
messages.description: The EV requests a certain current from the EVSE. Also, the target voltage, current and voltage difference are transferred.

messages.name: DC_ChargeLoopRes
messages.description: Response to the DC_ChargeLoopReq containing the acknowledgment status and present voltage as measured by the EVSE.

messages.name: DC_WeldingDetectionReq
messages.description: Requests welding detection on the EVSE side.

messages.name: DC_WeldingDetectionRes
messages.description: Response to the welding detection request from the EV.

messages.name: WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq
messages.description: Request sent by the EVCC to provide its WPT_Fine positioning setup parameters to the SECC.

messages.name: WPT_FinePositioningSetupRes
messages.description: Response sent by the SECC containing information about available options with respect to fine positioning, pairing, and alignment check.

messages.name: WPT_FinePositioningReq
messages.description: Continues the fine positioning process.

messages.name: WPT_FinePositioningRes
messages.description: Responds to the WPT_FinePositioningReq message.

messages.name: WPT_PairingReq
messages.description: Request message initiated by the EV to start the pairing process.

messages.name: WPT_PairingRes
messages.description: The SECC responds to the pairing request with this response.

messages.name: WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq
messages.description: Message used to request charge parameters for WPT.

messages.name: WPT_ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes
messages.description: Message used to respond with charge parameters for WPT.

messages.name: WPT_ChargeParameterDiscovery
messages.description: Negotiates the energy transfer parameters between the EVCC and the SECC after authorization for charging.

messages.name: WPT_AlignmentCheckReq
messages.description: Used to exchange information needed to perform the alignment check, with which the proper position of the EV device with the primary device is checked and confirmed.

messages.name: WPT_AlignmentCheckRes
messages.description: Response to WPT_AlignmentCheckReq, providing the results and status of the alignment check process.

messages.name: WPT_ChargeLoopReq
messages.description: Request message for the periodic exchange of process control data in WPT mode.

messages.name: WPT_ChargeLoopRes
messages.description: The response to the WPT_ChargeLoopReq, providing feedback on the power request.

messages.name: SupportedAppProtocol
messages.description: Message to negotiate supported application protocols.

messages.name: ACDP_VehiclePositioning
messages.description: Message specific to ACDP for vehicle positioning.

messages.description: Message to set up authorization.

messages.description: Message for authorization.

messages.name: CertificateInstallation

messages.name: ServiceDiscovery
messages.description: Message to discover available services.

messages.name: ServiceDetail
messages.description: Message to get details of a service.

messages.name: ServiceSelection
messages.description: Message to select a service.

messages.name: DC_ChargeParameterDiscovery
messages.description: Message for DC charge parameter discovery.

messages.name: ScheduleExchange
messages.description: Message to exchange schedules.

messages.name: ACDP_Connect
messages.description: Message specific to ACDP for connecting.

messages.name: DC_CableCheck
messages.description: Message for DC cable check.

messages.name: DC_PreCharge
messages.description: Message for DC pre-charge.

messages.name: PowerDelivery(Start)
messages.description: Message to start power delivery.

messages.name: DC_ChargeLoop
messages.description: Message for DC charge loop.

messages.name: PowerDelivery(Stop)
messages.description: Message to stop power delivery.

messages.name: ACDP_Disconnect
messages.description: Message specific to ACDP for disconnecting.

messages.name: MeteringConfirmation
messages.description: Confirms metering data.

messages.name: ACDP_SystemStatus
messages.description: Provides system status for ACDP.

messages.name: ACDP_VehiclePositioningReq
messages.description: Request for vehicle positioning information during the EV approaching process.

messages.name: ACDP_ConnectReq
messages.description: This message pattern is used to initiate the connecting process of the ACDP.

messages.name: ACDP_ConnectRes
messages.description: This message is the response to ACDP_ConnectReq, indicating the result of the connection process.

messages.name: ACDP_DisconnectReq
messages.description: Request message for disconnecting the ACDP device.

messages.name: ACDP_DisconnectRes
messages.description: Response message for the ACDP disconnect request.

messages.name: ACDP_SystemStatusReq
messages.description: This message is used to request the current status information of involved charging equipment.

messages.name: ACDP_SystemStatusRes
messages.description: This message provides the current status information of involved charging equipment in response to ACDP_SystemStatusReq.

messages.name: VehicleCheckInReq
messages.description: Used by a parking status service for an approaching EV to get information about an EVSE.

messages.name: VehicleCheckInRes
messages.description: Response to VehicleCheckInReq providing information such as target offset and distances.

messages.name: VehicleCheckOutReq
messages.description: Used by the EVCC to inform the SECC about the departure of the EV.

messages.name: VehicleCheckOutRes
messages.description: Response from the SECC to the EVCC regarding the VehicleCheckOut request.

messages.name: Dynamic_SEReqControlModeType
messages.description: Contains elements of the ScheduleExchangeReq message for the 'Dynamic' control mode.

messages.name: Scheduled_SEReqControlModeType
messages.description: Contains elements of the ScheduleExchangeReq message required for the Scheduled control mode.

messages.description: This type contains all elements of the AuthorizationReq message that are only required in case the authorization mode PnC is chosen.

messages.name: BPT_DC_CPDReqEnergyTransferModeType
messages.description: Contains elements defining the energy transfer mode for DC bidirectional charging requests.

messages.name: BPT_DC_CPDResEnergyTransferModeType
messages.description: Contains elements defining the energy transfer mode for DC bidirectional charging responses.
